notes: Corpus and coverage figures are from Track A's 2026-10-26 live data report. Fictional replay profiles are excluded. Reddit outcomes are self-reported and self-selected; the odds adjustment is approximate. Brier scores come from a held-out backtest of the latest 30% of posts (2341 admit/deny decisions), with the official admit rate as the base rate. Ranking within a school is weak (AUC about 0.53) and some income groups are poorly calibrated; see the report.
